statements.status_notes: This DHI package applies the upstream fix from https://github.com/skvadrik/re2c/commit/febeb977936f9519a25d9fbd10ff8256358cdb97 before building. The patch makes re2c reject entry/pre-rule/post-rule actions in blocks with no rules before determinization, so the NULL pointer dereference path is not present in the built package.

The re2c 4.1 source already contains the upstream fix from https://github.com/skvadrik/re2c/commit/5fffb1870181d6179118586e21ed2889b8b4abc8, which rewrites rule liveness analysis from recursive backpropagation to an iterative DfsBackprop stack in src/dfa/dead_rules.cc. The vulnerable recursive code path is not present in this DHI package version.
